title: Pure JUNK!
text: Pure JUNK!. This is a terrible product!  When I first put it together, it blew out mist for about 30 seconds and then nothing since then.  I've tried every workaround I can think of to it it going again.  It's pure junk! I cannot believe it has 4.5 stars.
